images.filename: 1915 postcard Niche in the Court of the Four Seasons with George Sterling verses.jpg
images.caption: Postcard shows verses by George Sterling inscribed in 3-foot-tall capital letters on 3 panels above 3 arches on the western wall of the Court of the Four Seasons at the 1915 Panama-Pacific International Exposition world's fair in San Francisco. The 6 lines come from Sterling's 1907 play The Triumph of Bohemia.
images.alt: Postcard shows verses by George Sterling inscribed in 3-foot-tall capital letters on 3 panels above 3 arches on the western wall of the Court of the Four Seasons at the 1915 Panama-Pacific International Exposition world's fair in San Francisco. The 6 lines come from Sterling's 1907 play The Triumph of Bohemia.
images.artist: "Cardinell Vincent Co. Mfg. San Francisco," according to credit on reverse.

images.filename: 1926 Dec Bohemian Club tribute to George Sterling.tif
images.caption: December 1926 memorial tribute card to poet and playwright George Sterling, published by the Bohemian Club, San Francisco, California.
images.alt: December 1926 memorial tribute card to poet and playwright George Sterling, published by the Bohemian Club, San Francisco, California.
images.artist: The board of directors of the Bohemian Club, San Francisco, California. 4 verses of a quoted poem were written by George Sterling, who died in 1926.
